title: Ego-depletion Registered Replication Report: protocol-specific null-compatible estimate
summary: Promotes the ego-depletion Registered Replication Report as a protocol-specific replication record. It captures a large multi-lab estimate that was compatible with no effect while preserving the guardrail that a single paradigm does not decide every possible resource, motivation, or self-control theory.
